name: Projector
role: The owner's notes over a markdown vault: a note with a status is work, one without a thought. The owner's commitments are the notes the vault's kernel.commitments axis calls open or answered; the days are its daily notes; intake triages what the kernel's connectors gathered (claude-code, git, jira, slack, gmail, run by the owner with bin/kernel sync) into inbox cards and proposals, each judging pass an attempt of judge-intake, and gathers nothing itself. The owner plans here, so projector publishes the daily plan and the weekly review, over every open intent in the ledger.
where: ~/Code/projects/projector; vaults listed in its vaults.json, each configured in <vault>/.projector/config.yaml
reach: work on a note: ~/Code/projects/kernel/bin/kernel worktree <the note's open intent> (or the kernel MCP tool worktree, or ▶ on the note in the app), an attempt of the kernel's worktree spec worked under its kernel-worktree skill; the kernel asks projector about the note through context

accepts.what: A task or a project: a change to make, a thing to build, fix, ship or decide
accepts.how: ~/.local/bin/pj --vault work add <title> --facet status=planning [--facet priority=<week|month|backlog|maybe>] [--facet project=<project note id>] [--body <the owner's details, and a 'Done when ...' line when they gave one>]; the values are the vault's .projector/facets.yaml
accepts.example: pj --vault work add "Fix the panel's missing drop button" --facet status=planning --facet priority=week

accepts.what: A note about work already in the vault: progress, a finding, a link for an existing task or project
accepts.how: ~/.local/bin/pj --vault work ls --q <words> finds the note and ~/.local/bin/pj --vault work context <note id> names its file; append the words as a paragraph at the end of that file (plain file writes are a vault's own write path, note-conventions C3)
accepts.example: a paragraph appended to projects/kernel/route-capture.md: "the route-capture spec landed; live check next"

queries.name: vault-intents
queries.description: Every intent, whatever its status, about this vault's notes: status, statement, horizon, the latest verdict and who gave it, and who proposed it when not the owner. One row per intent, note alias and piece of evidence the latest verdict cites; projector's board reads its kernel axis through it.

queries.name: vault-status-events
queries.description: The vault/status events projector's import sent about a note, newest first, with the payload it sent; given an alias prefix, every note's, each row naming its note. The import reads them back to key the next change, so the kernel is the only record of what was sent.

inputs.name: alias
inputs.description: a note's alias, vault:<vault>:<id>, or a vault's prefix, vault:<vault>:

queries.name: intake-proposals
queries.description: The intents projector's intake proposed that the owner has not answered yet: still proposed, with when and what each is about.

queries.name: intake-newest
queries.description: Where intake's triage got to: the newest intake/ event projector wrote, per intake channel. Projector judges the connector events newer than it, so the cursor is this answer and nothing is stored in the vault.

queries.name: connector-events-since
queries.description: The connector events intake triages: every event of the given kinds newer than an instant, with its kernel id, kind, when it happened, what it is about and its payload. One row per event and alias.

inputs.name: since
inputs.description: read events that happened after this instant

inputs.name: kinds
inputs.description: the kinds to read, space-separated and padded with spaces: " :claude/session :git/commit "

queries.name: connector-event
queries.description: One connector event by its kernel id, in connector-events-since's columns: how intake offers a declined candidate again once the owner takes the decline back.
